spans.s: भित्त n. 1. A part, a portion; 2. a fragment; 3. a wall, a partition.
भीत a. (f. ता) 1. Frightened, alarmed, afraid of, (with an abl.), न भीतो मरणादस्मि Mrich.x.; 2. imperiled, (pp. of भी q.v.).
भीत a. (f. ता) 1. Frightened, alarmed, afraid of, (with an abl.), न भीतो मरणादस्मि Mrich.x.; 2. imperiled, (pp. of भी q.v.).

भित्ति f. 1. A wall, a partition, बद्धां बद्धां भित्तिशंकाममुष्मिन् Kir.i.36, Sis.iv.67; 2. a mat; 3. anything broken; 4. a piece, a portion, a fragment; 5. a rent, a hole; 6. a flaw, a defect; 7. an opportunity.
भीति f. 1. Fear, apprehension, terror; 2. shaking, tremour.
भित्तिका f. 1. A wall, a partition; 2. a small lizard.
भीति-नाटितक n. mimic representation of fear.
